column3: The asset: a broadleaf tree about one and a half houses tall, an old oak with a thick short twisting trunk showing its roots flared at the base, and one big rounded crown built of four or five chunky lumpy leaf masses, deep green with warm sunlit tops; the trunk visible below the crown.

The asset: a broadleaf tree, a tall lime or beech with a straight sturdy trunk forking into two, and a taller oval crown of chunky clustered leaf masses in a lighter fresh green with ochre-gold highlights; the trunk visible below the crown.

The asset: a conifer, a tall stylised fir with a short visible brown trunk at the base and four or five stacked chunky tiers of drooping painted branches narrowing to a point, deep blue-green with lighter green tips.
The asset: a conifer, a broader stylised pine with a thick short trunk and a fat cone of chunky rounded branch clumps, mid green with lighter tips.
The asset: a round flowering garden bush about waist high, one dense chunky mound of painted leaves dotted with small red and yellow flowers, sitting flat on the ground.

The asset: a dense painted clump of meadow grass about knee high, thick chunky blades leaning outwards from the centre like a tuft, with three or four small white and yellow wildflowers, sitting flat on the ground; the blades thick and solid, not thin cards.
